card.name: The word "written" in prose
card.fires_on: The word "written" (often capitalized), either opening a byline such as "Written by..." after an article ends, or as an adjective before nouns like communication, language, record or assignments.

modes.label: Byline after article
modes.description: Capitalized "Written" starting a credit line right after the body text ends.

modes.label: Written as adjective
modes.description: "written" modifying a noun such as language, record, or assignments, in contrast to spoken.
modes.example: Struggling to understand or use spoken or<< written>> language.

card.writes: It promotes words like "records", "record" and "ized", which fits a noun such as record or material coming next.
card.plain: It lights up on the word "written", whether in a "Written by" credit or as in "written language".
